connectDescription: Choose what your source can send. The first successful push adds its account.
subscriptionHelp: Claude and Codex quotas are read on connected hosts. Sign in to the provider on that host; its next read adds the account. No outside report is needed.
otelHelp: Use OTLP/HTTP with delta metrics or supported spans. Point the exporter at this server's /v1/me/usage/otlp base and set Authorization: Bearer $USAGE_KEY. Retries may count twice. The sample sends one input-token reading.
vendorHelp: Import an unmodified vendor response. This LiteLLM key-info example reports a budget window, not a wallet. Replace the sample with your response. OpenAI and Anthropic usage and cost formats are also supported.
relayHelp: Import a vendor balance response. This example uses OpenRouter credits; openrouter-key and newapi-user are also supported. A balance never affects pace or routing.
reportHelp: When no standard exporter or official import fits, send an account report v2. Omitted sections keep their values; present sections replace them. Use one account id consistently.
manualHelp: Send a balance you know yourself. Edit the remaining amount and unit before running. Update or clear it with another report; it is a reading, not an automatically updated wallet.
undocumentedHelp: Run your own pusher and use account report v2. Unofficial endpoints can change without notice and may risk account suspension. No web-login scraper is built in.
copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the sample and copy it manually.
credentialHelp: Your server operator creates a user-owned API key with scope usage. Keep the raw key in your pusher as USAGE_KEY; the server stores its SHA-256 digest in api_keys. This page stores no credential.
storageHelp: Readings and activity live on the server under your account. Find them in Usage → account; change them by pushing to the same id. Stop the pusher, then remove the account in Account settings to delete its reading and activity.
preferencesHelp: Display choices are cached in this browser and synced to your user on this server. Change or reset a choice with its control (Auto, an empty field, or the switch). Clearing browser data removes the cache; synced choices return when you sign in.
